unit_label: BRBL::MOD_D::U05: Reconcile pledge-sale surplus and preserve the sale conditions

payload.stem_md: A pawnee sale produces more than the stipulated debt and recoverable expenses. The pawnee proposes keeping the surplus merely because default occurred. What follows under the described rule?

options.text_md: Default converts every surplus into lender profit
options.explanation_md: The source provides a surplus entitlement.

options.text_md: The surplus must be returned to the entitled pawnor under the applicable rule
options.explanation_md: Default does not create unrestricted ownership of excess proceeds.

options.text_md: Every recoverable expense must be ignored
The original pledge debt automatically doubles

payload.correct_explanation_md: Default does not create unrestricted ownership of excess proceeds.

payload.stem_md: A calculation correctly subtracts debt and stipulated recoverable expenses, but the file has no evidence of the required reasonable sale notice. What does the calculation establish?

options.text_md: Every sale condition was necessarily met
The pawnee automatically owns all other assets
No sale condition matters once the numbers reconcile
Only the stipulated arithmetic result; sale compliance still needs evidence
options.explanation_md: Correct computation and a lawful sale are separate questions.

payload.correct_explanation_md: Correct computation and a lawful sale are separate questions.

payload.title: Pledge-sale reconciliation and notice
payload.scenario_narrative_md: A defaulted pledge is sold. For the calculation, the debt, proceeds and recoverable expenses are stipulated. The reviewer must separately examine the sale-notice evidence and the treatment of any excess after the stated deductions.
